description: Phase 2 — Native Host & IPC Bridge: implement native_host.py and its unit tests. The native host is a standalone process that translates between Chrome Native Messaging 32-bit native-endian frames and the broker's Unix domain socket 32-bit big-endian frames. Depends on FEAT-001. Independent of FEAT-002/004/005/006 (no imports from engine).
steps: Create src/mcp_gateway/host/native_host.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/host/native_host.py. Implement the following: (a) CONSTANTS: CHROME_FRAME_FORMAT = '@I' (native endian, 4 bytes); IPC_FRAME_FORMAT = '>I' (big endian, 4 bytes); MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 1024 * 1024 (1 MiB, Chrome's host-to-browser limit); CHUNK_SIZE = 512 * 1024 (512 KiB slice threshold); IPC_SOCKET_PATH default '/tmp/mcp-gemini-broker.sock'. (b) Function read_native_message(stream: BinaryIO) -> bytes — reads exactly 4 bytes using struct.unpack('@I', ...) to get length N, then reads exactly N bytes; raises EOFError on short read; raises ValueError if N > MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE. (c) Function write_native_message(stream: BinaryIO, data: bytes) -> None — packs len(data) as struct.pack('@I', ...), writes header+data to stream, calls stream.flush(). (d) Function read_ipc_message(reader: asyncio.StreamReader) -> bytes — reads 4 bytes, unpacks with '>I', reads payload. (e) Function write_ipc_message(writer: asyncio.StreamWriter, data: bytes) -> None — packs len with '>I', writes header+data, drains. (f) Function chunk_message(data: bytes, chunk_size: int = CHUNK_SIZE) -> list[dict] — if len(data) <= chunk_size returns [{'payload': base64(data), 'chunk_index': 0, 'total_chunks': 1, 'final': True}]; otherwise splits into ceil(len/chunk_size) chunks, returns list of dicts with sequential indices and final=True on last only. (g) Async function connect_to_broker(socket_path: str) -> tuple[asyncio.StreamReader, asyncio.StreamWriter] — opens Unix domain socket connection; raises ConnectionRefusedError if broker not running. (h) Async function validate_origin(writer: asyncio.StreamWriter, allowed_extension_id: str) -> bool — sends a HELLO frame {'type':'hello','version':1} over IPC, awaits {'type':'hello_ack','extension_id': ...}, returns allowed_extension_id in ack. (i) Async function relay_loop(socket_path: str, allowed_extension_id: str) -> None — main event loop: reads native message from sys.stdin.buffer using read_native_message (run in executor to avoid blocking asyncio loop), forwards to broker via write_ipc_message, reads response from broker via read_ipc_message, chunks response via chunk_message, writes each chunk to sys.stdout.buffer via write_native_message. Logs only to sys.stderr — never to sys.stdout. Never logs message body content. (j) Function main() -> None — on Windows calls msvcrt.setmode(sys.stdin.fileno(), os.O_BINARY) and msvcrt.setmode(sys.stdout.fileno(), os.O_BINARY); sets UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=3 in os.environ; reads IPC_SOCKET_PATH from environment variable MCP_BROKER_SOCKET or default; reads ALLOWED_EXTENSION_ID from environment variable; calls asyncio.run(relay_loop(...)). (k) if __name__ == '__main__': main(). All functions fully type-annotated. Zero imports from src/mcp_gateway/engine/ or src/mcp_gateway/broker/ — standalone module.

Create tests/test_native_framing.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/tests/test_native_framing.py. Tests: (a) test_read_native_message_roundtrip — write a 4-byte native-endian length prefix + payload to a BytesIO, call read_native_message, assert payload returned correctly. (b) test_write_native_message_roundtrip — call write_native_message on a BytesIO, verify first 4 bytes decode as native-endian length, rest is payload. (c) test_ipc_big_endian_framing — verify that IPC_FRAME_FORMAT '>I' encodes 256 as b'\x00\x00\x01\x00' (big endian confirmation, not native). (d) test_chunk_message_small — chunk_message(b'hello') returns single chunk with final=True, chunk_index=0, total_chunks=1. (e) test_chunk_message_large — chunk_message(bytes(600*1024)) returns 2 chunks, first final=False, second final=True. (f) test_max_message_size_rejected — read_native_message raises ValueError when length header exceeds 1 MiB. (g) test_chrome_vs_ipc_byte_order — explicitly assert '@I' and '>I' pack the same integer differently on little-endian x86 (struct.pack('@I', 1) == b'\x01\x00\x00\x00' and struct.pack('>I', 1) == b'\x00\x00\x00\x01' on LE arch).
Update src/mcp_gateway/host/__init__.py to export read_native_message, write_native_message, chunk_message, relay_loop, main.
acceptance_criteria: uv run mypy --strict src/mcp_gateway/host/ reports zero errors
uv run pytest tests/test_native_framing.py -v — all tests pass
native_host.py contains zero imports from engine, broker, or storage subpackages
sys.stdout is only written via write_native_message — no print() calls anywhere in native_host.py
